title: Conversation 2026-11-12: Publishing the theory-of-change essay, and reviewing references before affirming

sections.name: summary
sections.content: Owner and Claude Code took the muDemocracy essay 'Rebuilding Small Democracy' (muSrs 7da63d85) to a public 1.0: fact-checked it against the chain 'μ.democracy theory of change' (85c4e452), added the six-question checklist, gathered evidence, and published it at mudemocracy.org/ideas/rebuilding-small-democracy (muDemocracy.org#488, #489). Reviewing the references before publishing exposed that the essay editor gives no way to see a reference, or what it is linked to, before affirming it.
